p: all times into the holy place: The high priest entered into the holiest of holies just once a year in the month of September.

scapegoat: In Hebrew it is called Azazel, which some say is a mountain near Sinai, where this goat was sent. Rather it is called the scapegoat because it was not offered but sent into the desert, as in Le 16:11.
eastward: That is, on the side which was toward the people: for the head of the sanctuary stood westward.
remaineth among them in the midst: Placed among them who are unclean.
altar that is before the LORD: Upon which the sweet incense and perfume was offered.
upon the head of the goat: In this goat is a true figure of Jesus Christ, who bears the sins of the people, Is 53:9.
the holy place: In the court where the laver was, Ex 30:28.
seventh month: Which was Tisri, part September and part October.
afflict your souls: Meaning, by abstinence and fasting, Nu 29:7.
sabbath of rest unto you: Or a rest which you shall keep most diligently.
whom he shall anoint: Whom the priest shall anoint by God's commandment to succeed in his father's place.
